name: detectors/terms-phone-basic
description: Client terms (longest first, case-insensitive), phone numbers, Basic auth and a single-label Host header.

steps.input:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: intranet
Authorization: Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz

Welcome to Globex Corp (GLOBEX). Call +1 555-123-4567.

expect.equals:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: target1.example
Authorization: Basic [BASIC_1]

Welcome to [CLIENT_1] ([CLIENT_2]). Call [PHONE_1].

GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: intranet
Authorization: Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz

Welcome to globex corp (globex). Call +1 555-123-4567.

steps.note: terms are keyed lowercase, so restore gives the lowercase form
